messages:
rina_mktg: Heads-up: conversion dip this morning traced to ~3-6m assignment delays. probable enrichment + RR churn. Can we sketch a fast mitigation we can deploy today?

kevin_salesops: seen it. HubSpot returns 202 for enrichment, our RR keeps retrying and sometimes assigns to wrong geo pool. leads sit unowned.

olga_eng: propose temporary "ENRICH_PIN" with short TTL (120s). While pinned, RR should not move lead between pools and should allow only one claim attempt. Also dedupe claims by lead_id within 30s.

rina_mktg: that sounds good. we should also add a fallback email to SDRs for leads unassigned >2m (short-term manual rescue).

sdp_sdr: happy to take the digest. keep it lightweight (lead, source, time, quick link).

webhook-bot: note: HubSpot may send duplicate events. Recommend idempotency using eventId + external_id.

kevin_salesops: playbook items (short):
- if webhook responds 202 -> set ENRICH_PIN, ttl=120s
- block RR pool moves while pin active
- dedupe claims: ignore duplicate claim attempts within 30s window
- alert: if unassigned_count > 15 for 10m -> page oncall

olga_eng: eng tasks i can own today: add ENRICH_PIN flag + TTL, add claim dedupe, expose metric enrich_pin_count. will ramp to canary 10% first.

rina_mktg: ops tasks: update SDR digest + playbook note and schedule Monday smoke test.

sdp_sdr: i'll stand watch this weekend and triage digest.

olga_eng: deploying canary now to 10% traffic -> staging passing. will open PR link after smoke.

rina_mktg: thanks team. keep thread updated with metrics (time_to_assign median, unassigned_count). we'll evaluate after 24h. :thumbsup:
